Processing Data

Removing irrelevant variables

guns <- guns |>
  select(-rownames)
guns <- guns |>
  select(-BackChk)

Reducing the number of categories of the state variable by creating new variables describing regions that states fall into

# RUN ALL THE SECTIONS, COPY AND PASTE THE FINAL BIT INTO YOUR FORMULAS
#Sub-Regional Categories
guns = mutate(guns, 
Pacific = (state %in% c("Alaska", "California", "Hawaii", "Oregon", "Washington"))*1,
Mountain = (state %in% c("Arizona", "Colorado", "Idaho", "New Mexico", "Montana", "Utah",  "Nevada", "Wyoming"))*1, 
WestSouthCentral = (state %in% c("Arkansas", "Louisiana", "Oklahoma", "Texas"))*1,
EastSouthCentral = (state %in% c("Alabama", "Kentucky", "Mississippi", "Tennessee"))*1,
SouthAtlantic = (state %in% c("Delaware", "Florida", "Georgia", "Maryland", "North Carolina", "South Carolina", "Virginia", "West Virginia"))*1,
WestNorthCentral = (state %in% c("Iowa", "Kansas", "Minnesota", "Missouri", "Nebraska", "North Dakota", "South Dakota")*1),
EastNorthCentral = (state %in% c("Indiana", "Illinois", "Michigan", "Ohio", "Wisconsin"))*1,
MiddleAtlantic = (state %in% c("New Jersey", "New York", "Pennsylvania"))*1,
NewEngland = (state %in% c("Connecticut", "Maine", "Massachusetts", "New Hampshire", "Rhode Island", "Vermont"))*1, .after = -1)

#Broader Region Categories
guns = mutate(guns, 
West = (Pacific | Mountain)*1, 
South = (SouthAtlantic | EastSouthCentral | WestSouthCentral)*1,
Midwest = (EastNorthCentral | WestNorthCentral)*1,
Northeast = (NewEngland | MiddleAtlantic)*1, .after = -1)

Removing the state variable from the data set after creating region variables

guns <- guns |>
  select(-state)
glimpse(guns)

guns <- guns |> 
  mutate(across(Pacific:Northeast, as.factor)) #turning new region variables into categorical variables

Ensuring other categorical variables are read as factors:

guns$shall_carry <- factor(guns$shall_carry)
guns$universl <- factor(guns$universl)
guns$permit <- factor(guns$permit)

Removing any rows with N/A values:

guns <- na.omit(guns)

Partitioning data into training and testing data:

set.seed(237)
indexes <- sample(1:nrow(guns), 0.8*nrow(guns))
train <- guns[indexes, ]
test <- guns[-indexes, ]

Predicting the presence of whether or not state has universal background check laws

Creating universl recipe

r1 <- recipe(universl ~ ., data = train) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_factor_predictors()) |>
  prep()

train_ready_1 <- r1 |>
  bake(new_data = NULL)
test_ready_1 <- r1 |>
  bake(new_data = test)

creating lasso/Ridge matrices

x1 <- train_ready_1 |>
  select(-universl) |>
  as.matrix()
y1 <- train_ready_1 |>
  select(universl) |>
  as.matrix()
x_test_1 <- test_ready_1 |>
  select(-universl) |>
  as.matrix()

Lasso Model

set.seed(237)
cv_lasso_1 <- cv.glmnet(x1, y1, alpha = 1, family = "binomial", nfolds = 10, type.measure = "class")
plot(cv_lasso_1)

cv_lasso_1$lambda.min # lambda that gives the smallest classification error
## [1] 4.435432e-05
cv_lasso_1$cvm[which.min(cv_lasso_1$lambda)] # smallest classification error
## [1] 0.05875
optim_lasso_1 <- glmnet(x1, y1, alpha = 1, family = "binomial", lambda = cv_lasso_1$lambda.min, type.measure = "class")
probs_lasso_1 <- predict(optim_lasso_1, x_test_1, type = "response")
class_lasso_1 <- if_else(probs_lasso_1 > 0.5, 1, 0)
tidy(optim_lasso_1)
## # A tibble: 28 × 5
##    term         step estimate    lambda dev.ratio

Test proportion of incorrect classifications

mean(test_ready_1$universl != class_lasso_1)
## [1] 0.095

Confusion table

table(class_lasso_1, test_ready_1$universl)
##              
## class_lasso_1   0   1
##             0 159  11
##             1   8  22

ROC Curve and AUC

pred_auc_lasso_1 <- prediction(probs_lasso_1, test_ready_1$universl)

perf_lasso_1 <- performance(pred_auc_lasso_1, "auc")

#printing the AUC
auc_lasso_1 <- perf_lasso_1@y.values[[1]]
auc_lasso_1
## [1] 0.9598984

Ridge logistic regression

set.seed(237)
cv_ridge_1 <- cv.glmnet(x1, y1, alpha = 0, family = "binomial", nfolds = 10, type.measure = "class")
plot(cv_ridge_1)

cv_ridge_1$lambda.min # lambda that gives the smallest classification error
## [1] 0.02312638
cv_ridge_1$cvm[which.min(cv_ridge_1$lambda)] # smallest classification error
## [1] 0.0925
optim_ridge_1 <- glmnet(x1, y1, alpha = 0, family = "binomial", lambda = cv_ridge_1$lambda.min, type.measure = "class")
probs_ridge_1 <- predict(optim_ridge_1, x_test_1, type = "response")
class_ridge_1 <- if_else(probs_ridge_1 > 0.5, 1, 0)
tidy(optim_ridge_1)

AUC

#### ROC Curve and AUC
pred_auc_ridge_1 <- prediction(probs_ridge_1, test_ready_1$universl)

perf_ridge_1 <- performance(pred_auc_ridge_1, "auc")

#printing the AUC

## [1] 0.9286881

Naive Bayes Classification Model

bayes_1 <- naive_Bayes(mode = "classification") |>
  fit(universl ~.,  data = train_ready_1)

pred_bayes_1 <- predict(bayes_1, test_ready_1)
pred_classes_bayes_1 <- pred_bayes_1$.pred_class
actual_bayes_1 <- test_ready_1$universl

Confustion Table

table(pred_classes_bayes_1, actual_bayes_1)
##                     actual_bayes_1
## pred_classes_bayes_1   0   1
##                    0 157  16
##                    1  10  17

Test Classification error

mean(actual_bayes_1 != pred_classes_bayes_1)
## [1] 0.13

AUC

pred_probs_bayes_1 <- predict(bayes_1, test_ready_1, type = "prob")
probs_bayes_1 <- pred_probs_bayes_1$.pred_1

pred_auc_bayes_1 <- prediction(probs_bayes_1, actual_bayes_1)
perf_bayes_1 <- performance(pred_auc_bayes_1, "auc")

auc_bayes_1 <- perf_bayes_1@y.values[[1]]
auc_bayes_1
## [1] 0.9185266

Logistic Regression for classification

full_model_universl <- glm(universl~.-cauc -Male_FS_S  -robbery, family = "binomial", data = train_ready_1)

logistic_1 <- stats:: step(full_model_universl, direction = "backward")

KNN for Classification

library(tidymodels)
library(dplyr)

# Define the KNNmodeler3 function
KNNmodeler3 <- function(list_of_values, prediction_type, knn_mode_type, training_data, testing_data, response_var_name, formula) {
  
  # Initialize lists for storing accuracies and k values
  list_of_Accuracy <- c()
  list_of_K <- c()
  list_of_probabilites <- c()
  
  
  # Loop through modeling and testing for all provided values of k
  for (k in list_of_values) {
    
    # Define and fit the k-NN model
    knn_model <- nearest_neighbor(
      neighbors = k,
      mode = knn_mode_type,
      weight_func = "rectangular",
      dist_power = 2
    ) |> 
      fit(formula, data = training_data)
    
    # Predict on the testing data
    if(prediction_type == 'prob') {
    predictions <- predict(knn_model, new_data = testing_data, type = prediction_type) 
    probs <- unlist(predictions)
    list_of_probabilites <- probs } 
    
    else{predictions <- predict(knn_model, new_data = testing_data, type = prediction_type) |>
      unlist()
    
    # Calculate accuracy
    actuals <- testing_data[[response_var_name]]
    accuracy <- mean(predictions == actuals, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Store results
    list_of_Accuracy <- c(list_of_Accuracy, accuracy)
    list_of_K <- c(list_of_K, k) }
  }
  
  if(prediction_type == "class") {
  
  # Results reporting
  print("List of Accuracy Scores")
  print(list_of_Accuracy)
  print("List of K-values")
  print(list_of_K)
  
  # Identify the highest accuracy and corresponding k value
  highest_Accuracy <- max(list_of_Accuracy)
  indexed_Accuracy <- which(list_of_Accuracy == highest_Accuracy)
  
  # Return information for the best model
 return(list(best_k = list_of_K[indexed_Accuracy], best_accuracy = highest_Accuracy))}
  
  else if(prediction_type == "prob"){
    return(list(probabilities = list_of_probabilites))
  }
}
KNN1_class <- KNNmodeler3(
  list_of_values = 1:50,                  
  prediction_type = "class",               
  knn_mode_type = "classification",       
  training_data = train_ready_1,           
  testing_data = test_ready_1,             
  response_var_name = "universl",          
  formula = universl ~ .                   
)

auc_KNN_1
## [1] 0.9020142

Predicting whether or not shall-carry laws are present

Creating shall-carry recipe

r2 <- recipe(shall_carry ~ ., data = train) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_factor_predictors()) |>
  prep()

train_ready_2 <- r2 |>
  bake(new_data = NULL)
test_ready_2 <- r2 |>
  bake(new_data = test)

creating lasso/Ridge matrices for shall-carry

x2 <- train_ready_2 |>
  select(-shall_carry) |>
  as.matrix()
y2 <- train_ready_2 |>
  select(shall_carry) |>
  as.matrix()
x_test_2 <- test_ready_2 |>
  select(-shall_carry) |>
  as.matrix()

Lasso Model

set.seed(237)
cv_lasso_2 <- cv.glmnet(x2, y2, alpha = 1, family = "binomial", nfolds = 10, type.measure = "class")
plot(cv_lasso_2)

cv_lasso_2$lambda.min # lambda that gives the smallest classification error
## [1] 0.0002499174
cv_lasso_2$cvm[which.min(cv_lasso_2$lambda)] # smallest classification error
## [1] 0.1275
optim_lasso_2 <- glmnet(x2, y2, alpha = 1, family = "binomial", lambda = cv_lasso_2$lambda.min, type.measure = "class")
probs_lasso_2 <- predict(optim_lasso_2, x_test_2, type = "response")
class_lasso_2 <- if_else(probs_lasso_2 > 0.5, "yes", "no")
tidy(optim_lasso_2)
## # A tibble: 27 × 5
##    term         step estimate   lambda dev.ratio
##    <chr>       <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>

## 10 population      1   -0.319 0.000250     0.582
## # ℹ 17 more rows

Test proportion of incorrect classifications

mean(test_ready_2$shall_carry != class_lasso_2)
## [1] 0.16

Confusion table

table(class_lasso_2, test_ready_2$shall_carry)

## class_lasso_2  no yes

##           yes  19  41

AUC

pred_auc_lasso_2 <- prediction(probs_lasso_2, test_ready_2$shall_carry)

perf_lasso_2 <- performance(pred_auc_lasso_2, "auc")

#printing the AUC

KNN_2_prob <- KNNmodeler3(
  list_of_values = 1:50,                  
  prediction_type = "prob",               
  knn_mode_type = "classification",       
  training_data = train_ready_2,           
  testing_data = test_ready_2,             
  response_var_name = "shall_carry",         
  formula = shall_carry ~ .                   
)
probs_KNN2 <- KNN_2_prob$probabilities[201:400]
actual <- test_ready_2$shall_carry
pred <- prediction(probs_KNN2, actual)
perf <- performance(pred, "auc")
auc_KNN_2 <- perf@y.values[[1]]
auc_KNN_2
## [1] 0.867136

Predicting whether or not permit to purchase laws are in place

Creating permit to purchase recipe

r3 <- recipe(permit ~ ., data = train) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_factor_predictors()) |>
  prep()

train_ready_3 <- r3 |>
  bake(new_data = NULL)
test_ready_3 <- r3 |>
  bake(new_data = test)

creating lasso/Ridge matrices for shall-carry

x3 <- train_ready_3 |>
  select(-permit) |>
  as.matrix()
y3 <- train_ready_3 |>
  select(permit) |>
  as.matrix()
x_test_3 <- test_ready_3 |>
  select(-permit) |>
  as.matrix()

Lasso Model

set.seed(237)
cv_lasso_3 <- cv.glmnet(x3, y3, alpha = 1, family = "binomial", nfolds = 10, type.measure = "class")
plot(cv_lasso_3)

cv_lasso_3$lambda.min # lambda that gives the smallest classification error
## [1] 0.0006781792
cv_lasso_3$cvm[which.min(cv_lasso_3$lambda)] # smallest classification error
## [1] 0.025
optim_lasso_3 <- glmnet(x3, y3, alpha = 1, family = "binomial", lambda = cv_lasso_3$lambda.min, type.measure = "class")
probs_lasso_3 <- predict(optim_lasso_3, x_test_3, type = "response")
class_lasso_3 <- if_else(probs_lasso_3 > 0.5, 1, 0)
tidy(optim_lasso_3)
## # A tibble: 25 × 5
##    term         step estimate   lambda dev.ratio
##    <chr>       <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>
##  1 (Intercept)     1  -7.88   0.000678     0.833
##  2 year            1   1.08   0.000678     0.833
##  3 violent         1   2.30   0.000678     0.833
##  4 murder          1   0.252  0.000678     0.833
##  5 robbery         1  -1.57   0.000678     0.833
##  6 prisoners       1  -0.719  0.000678     0.833
##  7 afam            1   0.619  0.000678     0.833
##  8 cauc            1  -0.964  0.000678     0.833
##  9 male            1   0.347  0.000678     0.833
## 10 population      1   0.0662 0.000678     0.833
## # ℹ 15 more rows

Test proportion of incorrect classifications

mean(test_ready_3$permit != class_lasso_3)
## [1] 0.02

Confusion table

table(class_lasso_3, test_ready_3$permit)
##              
## class_lasso_3   0   1
##             0 156   3
##             1   1  40

AUC

pred_auc_lasso_3 <- prediction(probs_lasso_3, test_ready_3$permit)

perf_lasso_3 <- performance(pred_auc_lasso_3, "auc")

#printing the AUC
auc_lasso_3 <- perf_lasso_3@y.values[[1]]
auc_lasso_3
## [1] 0.9949637

Ridge logistic regression

cv_ridge_3$lambda.min # lambda that gives the smallest classification error
## [1] 0.05500921
cv_ridge_3$cvm[which.min(cv_ridge_3$lambda)] # smallest classification error
## [1] 0.02375
optim_ridge_3 <- glmnet(x3, y3, alpha = 0, family = "binomial", lambda = cv_ridge_3$lambda.min, type.measure = "class")
probs_ridge_3 <- predict(optim_ridge_3, x_test_3, type = "response")
class_ridge_3 <- if_else(probs_ridge_3 > 0.5, 1, 0)

Naive Bayes Classification Model

KNN_3_prob <- KNNmodeler3(
  list_of_values = 1:50,                  
  prediction_type = "prob",               
  knn_mode_type = "classification",       
  training_data = train_ready_3,           
  testing_data = test_ready_3,             
  response_var_name = "permit",         
  formula = permit ~ . )

actual <- test_ready_3$permit
pred <- prediction(probs_KNN3, actual)
